lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Olivia Adler is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Olivia is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Olivia Adler is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Olivia kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Olivia's gone." Raul looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Olivia." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Elif blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Olivia Adler, 40 days. The mantle passes to Elif Demir.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Elif Demir, 45 — a hotel housekeeper. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally, Cornucopia.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Olivia — and Olivia is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Colin, Raul, Josefina and 3 more speak for Elif — "Olivia trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Elif before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d110: 🍽️ Ethan looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: The village threw out spoiled stores: 57 Chickweed, 12 Foraged food, Foraged food. (pantry)
d111: 💬 Nikolai says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
